title: PreciseEdit: Strong Yet Stable Semantic Transport for One-Step Image Editing
title_zh: PreciseEdit：面向单步图像编辑的强而稳定的语义迁移方法

paragraphs.en: 总结：PreciseEdit提出一种无需训练和反演的单步图像编辑框架，通过双噪声尺度角色分解实现强语义迁移与背景保真的平衡，性能达到SOTA。 Recent one-step text-to-image (T2I) models enable efficient image synthesis, opening up new possibilities for interactive Web-based image editing. However, existing one-step editing methods often construct a global transport field through simple vector operations between conditional predictions. While such strong transport can effectively drive the image toward the target semantics, it may be released along unreliable directions or over non-edited regions, leading to structural distortions within the editing region and background drift elsewhere. More importantly, stabilizing the editing process through global smoothing or uniformly weakening the transport field often makes large semantic changes overly conservative. In this work, we revisit one-step image editing from the perspective of the tension between semantic strength and transport stability, and identify a key insight: strong semantic transport is not inherently unstable. What matters is whether it is applied along reliable directions and at reliable spatial locations. Motivated by this insight, we introduce PreciseEdit, a model-agnostic, training-free and inversion-free one-step editing framework that strengthens target-semantic alignment while preserving background fidelity and structural consistency. We further propose a dual-noise-scale role decomposition strategy: a higher-noise scale produces the strong target-directed transport used for actual editing, whereas a lower-noise scale jointly serves as a probe for directional agreement and spatial structure. Extensive experiments on PIE-Bench demonstrate that PreciseEdit achieves state-of-the-art performance and effectiveness on various editing tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：PreciseEdit提出一种无需训练和反演的单步图像编辑框架，通过双噪声尺度角色分解实现强语义迁移与背景保真的平衡，性能达到SOTA。最近的一步式文生图（T2I）模型能够实现高效的图像合成，为基于Web的交互式图像编辑开辟了新的可能性。 然而，现有的一步式编辑方法通常通过条件预测之间的简单向量运算来构建全局传输场。 这种强传输虽然能有效驱动图像朝向目标语义，但可能沿着不可靠的方向或在非编辑区域释放，导致编辑区域内部出现结构失真，而其他区域则发生背景漂移。 更重要的是，通过全局平滑或统一削弱传输场来稳定编辑过程，往往会使大幅度的语义变化变得过于保守。 在本工作中，我们从语义强度与传输稳定性之间的张力出发重新审视一步式图像编辑，并得出一个关键洞察：强语义传输并非天然不稳定。 关键在于它是否沿着可靠的方向并在可靠的空间位置上施加。 受此洞察启发，我们提出PreciseEdit，一个与模型无关、无需训练且无需反演的一步式编辑框架，它在强化目标语义对齐的同时保持背景保真度与结构一致性。 我们进一步提出一种双噪声尺度角色分解策略：较高噪声尺度产生用于实际编辑的强目标导向传输，而较低噪声尺度则同时充当方向一致性探测器和空间结构探测器。 在PIE-Bench上的大量实验表明，PreciseEdit在各种编辑任务上达到了最先进的性能并展现出有效性。
